title: Orient Express
summary:
Turkey's role in the tanker market
Last weekend, the world witnessed a failed coup attempt in Turkey. While this event was going on, we received several questions on the oil volumes passing through Turkey. Even though the coup attempt failed and the transportation situation normalized quickly thereafter, we thought it would be interesting to take a look at the importance of Turkey to the tanker market.
